Medical Groups Issue Vaccine Guidance Amid Federal Silence

Leading medical organizations in the U.S. have released their own recommendations for COVID-19, flu, and RSV vaccines for the fall season. This action comes in the absence of federal guidance from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The doctors aim to provide clarity and ease confusion for the public regarding vaccination schedules and eligibility. The guidance covers updated advice on which vaccines are recommended and for whom, filling a perceived void left by the federal agency.
